from datetime import datetime,timedelta,timezone
import hashlib,json
from research.target_price_revisions_qc import extended_mia_capture as m
created=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
try:
    plan=m.prepare_plan(action="baseline-source",operation_id="TPR-EXT26-MIA-SOURCE-BASELINE-20261022-005",owner_instruction_sha256="4cbdbec4c54b5db78455516442f96c25d636af6e54a214209cef5419e301b9aa",created_utc=created.isoformat(),expires_utc=(created+timedelta(minutes=15)).isoformat())
    raw=m.execute_plan(plan)
    value=m.e.parse_json(raw)
    keys=("operation_id","status","git_head","plan_sha256","ended_utc","read_attempts","received_bytes","baseline_read_bytes","stable_source_inventory","baseline_expected_files_equal","source_archives","inventory","missing_expected_files","different_expected_files","unexpected_files","new_codex_attempts","new_looks")
    public={k:value[k] for k in keys}
    public.update(receipt_bytes=len(raw),receipt_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
    print(m.e.canonical(public).decode())
except (Exception,KeyboardInterrupt) as exc:
    print(json.dumps({"operation_id":"TPR-EXT26-MIA-SOURCE-BASELINE-20261022-005","status":"PREPARATION_OR_EFFECT_UNCERTAIN","error_type":type(exc).__name__,"automatic_retry":False}))
